title: Department of Homeland Security: Phase 56G Acquisition Check
publisher: Department of Homeland Security Office of Inspector General
summary: The DHS OIG report index was checked on July 24, 2026. It did not expose a final FY 2025 enterprise FISMA evaluation; the existing project record remains the latest exact review identifier in the FTFN evidence stack. Phase 56G decision: No closure change. A current report-index check cannot be converted into an annual outcome.
key_findings: Highest-value missing record: Released FY 2025 enterprise FISMA result.
Continuation rule: Reopen when DHS OIG publishes the final FY 2025 enterprise evaluation or a dated replacement outcome.
why_it_matters: The acquisition check tests one named reopening rule without allowing adjacent context to stand in for the requested operating or closure record.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves the stable entity ID agency-dhs.
Records the exact official or first-party rail checked and the result at a date.
Separates a useful contextual record from the narrower evidence needed to change closure state.
evidence_limits: A dated index check establishes the public-report boundary at capture; it does not prove that no nonpublic work exists or supply the missing annual result.
Released FY 2025 evaluation, component findings, closure dates, endpoint and cloud coverage, incidents, recovery, and service effects.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
